text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak says he is ready to host any summit of Arafat, King Hussein and Netanyahu as part of efforts to support the peace process.

- Mubarak and Ugandan President Museveni hold talks in Cairo on ways to boost bilateral cooperation. Foreign Minister Amr Moussa will visit Kampala in the coming week for more consultations. Talks centred on agricultural and industrial cooperation as well as joint investment as well as the situation in east Africa.
- International Monetary Fund's Howard Handy says that Egypt has started to reap the fruits of its economic reform programme.
- Cabinet is to discuss today the 83 billion pounds federal budget for 97/98 and the trip to Asia of Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri.
- Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid will discuss with Paris Club countries on May 7 and 8 increasing aid and grants to Egypt of $500 million a year for the next five years.
